thread:
Nina Patel: Need to fast-track an offer for Rafa (returning contractor) — London-based, asked for local GBP pay. He did 3 months last year; manager wants him back for a short 4-month build to unblock inference infra.
Jordan Lee: Band lookup shows this role S3. Manager is proposing S4-equivalent pay: GBP 85k annualized pro-rated for 4 months + £2,000 sign-on. Also asking for a one-time deferred token grant if converted within 6 months.
Amir Khan (Hiring Manager): Rafa is high-impact and already ramped. Conversion probability low but possible. Start target 2026-06-01, fully remote UK. No relocation. We're asking for the premium because market in London subs > S3 cap.
Sofia Morales (Finance): For band exceptions >10% we need director sign-off and budget confirmation. Please provide cost_center, budget_owner, and confirm total cash outflow (GBP gross for 4 months + sign-on). Also flag: equity/token grants need approval from comp committee.
Nina Patel: cost_center: ENG-INF-210, budget_owner: Jordan Lee, total cash = GBP 28,333 (pro-rated) + £2,000 sign-on = GBP 30,333 gross. Equity ask is a one-time deferred token grant contingent on conversion; manager wants it recorded but paid only if conversion occurs.
Sofia Morales: OK routing: people-ops -> finance -> comp-committee -> legal. Ping offers-bot to create ticket.
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-9007. Routing path: people-ops -> finance -> comp-committee -> legal. Link: https://redwood.in/offers/APP-9007
Jordan Lee: Note UK-specific tax compliance: Legal/People Ops — watch for IR35/worker status risk for a returning contractor with prior engagement. We should include a contractor engagement checklist and EoR options.
Sofia Morales: Finance provisional OK for cash numbers pending comp-committee on the deferred grant. Approve pending confirmation of correct payroll vehicle (EoR vs direct contractor) and VAT/tax treatment. :white_check_mark:
Sofia Morales: Also need PO or budget tag; please attach to APP-9007.
Amir Khan: Pasted market rationale into ticket: "London market premium for model-serving infra; expedited delivery window; candidate is already ramped reducing onboarding overhead. Temporary premium requested for 4-month fixed term."
offers-bot: APP-9007 routed to Comp Committee at 2945678930.
Comp-Committee (automated note): Deferred token grant requires express committee approval; please include valuation cap, vesting trigger, and maximum payout. Routing to Legal for IR35 review.
Sofia Morales: Finance approves cash and sign-on conditional on Legal/IR35 clearance and comp-committee approval for any deferred token. :thumbsup:
Nina Patel: Legal: any recommended clause for offer to mitigate worker status risk?
Sofia Morales: Legal flagged IR35 exposure. Suggest standard clause: "Engagement is on a fixed-term contractor basis; duties, control, and delivery milestones defined; if the engagement is reclassified, Redwood will comply with applicable tax and benefit obligations and make necessary adjustments." Also recommend EoR route for payroll to reduce risk.
Nina Patel: Added clauses to APP-9007 and updated the offer draft. ETA to finalize: EOD if comp-committee confirms deferred grant and Legal clears IR35 note.
Amir Khan: Thanks — can People Ops send the offer email once cleared? We want Rafa to accept within 48 hours.
Nina Patel: Will do. APP-9007 status: pending comp-committee decision and legal IR35 review. offers-bot: APP-9007 updated at 2945678965."
